description: Panel for managing a public share link to a signing document. Provides an enable/disable toggle, a read-only copyable link, optional expiration display, and optional QR code and embeddable snippet.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: EmbedCode
parameters.description: Optional embed code for publishing the signing link.

parameters.name: EnabledChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when sharing is enabled or disabled.

parameters.name: ShowQrCode
parameters.description: Whether a QR code is rendered.
